title: Rename each PcbLib's footprint to its file name
summary: Batch-opens every .PcbLib in a folder, renames its footprint (Pattern) to the file name inside a modification bracket, saves with DoFileSave and closes it again, skipping libraries that are open or hold several footprints.
phrasings: batch rename footprints in PCB libraries
set footprint name from library file name
open, edit and save a PcbLib from code
list the footprints of a PcbLib file

commands.name: RenameFootprintsToFileName
commands.description: Rename each PcbLib footprint in a folder to the file name
commands.params: Folder=<folder> (required on the pipe; dialog from the menu)|MultiFootprint=Skip|Current (default Skip)|Out=<folder> (default temp)|Open=true|false (default: true from the menu, false on the pipe)

commands.name: ListFootprints
commands.description: List the footprints of a PcbLib file (read-back check)
